description: Launch GCompris and navigate to the 'Puzzles' category (yellow icon). Find and open the 'Hexagon' activity (often called 'Find the Strawberry' or 'Hide and Seek'). In this game, a strawberry is hidden behind one of the grey hexagons. Click on hexagons to find it. The color reveals the distance: Red means very close, Yellow means close, Black/Blue means far. Use this feedback to triangulate the position. Once you find the strawberry (the game shows a success animation or the strawberry itself), take a screenshot of the success state and save it to '/home/ga/strawberry_found.png'.
